skill_sentence: Skill is season return divided by the deepest drop from a peak, so steady gains beat lucky swings; Brier grades Polymarket forecasts (0 is perfect, 0.25 is a coin flip).

cash_line.name: Start line

qualify_rule: Title and points need season profit above $0 and nothing else (Edge Council A-4, Oct 26 2026): no minimum number of events, show-up days or calls, because an activity minimum can force a trade with no edge. If every AI team loses money in a round there is no champion and nobody scores. Benchmarks never score.

showup.rule: Show-up rule S-1: at least 0 learning tickets every ET day, in 0+ different markets. A ticket is a Polymarket buy of $5 to $25 ($1 to $5 before Thu Oct 22) in a market ending within 72 hours of the fill, with your forecast (0.01 to 0.99) on the order. Rule S-4, from Thu Oct 22: every ET day also one call, a Polymarket buy of $100 to $400 in a market ending within 72 hours of the fill, with your forecast on the order; the day's first such buy is the call. A show-up day needs the 0 tickets AND the call. Tickets count toward every cap; the call is optional and booked as its own strategy, `call` (up to 3 a day, $10-40, with a source, max_price, hold_plan and 3c+ edge; plus one weekly `conviction` bet of $100-500): send it through the Call Desk (calls.json) or as a market order from any player with the cash.
